intent.proves: Custom product fields (category fields and global custom fields together) use at least the selected profile's number of distinct field types; the text-like types count once.
intent.scope: All category fields except the reference category, and every global product field that is not standard.

bindings.reason: Live parity review found category-field projection differs from complete stored-field scope or omits presentation. Do not claim equivalence. The category field tool also omits global custom fields.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN x.FieldType IN (1, 10, 11, 12, 13) THEN 1 ELSE x.FieldType END) FROM (SELECT f.FieldType FROM EcomProductCategoryField f WHERE f.FieldCategoryId <> N'reference_category' UNION ALL SELECT g.ProductFieldTypeId FROM EcomProductField g WHERE g.ProductFieldIsStandard = 0) x
